title: replacement.assigned payload (v1)
description: Wire payload of `replacement.assigned`. Tells a workflow consumer that the capability gap a blocking recusal opened has been closed - without naming who closed it. No field in this payload carries an identity attribute, a global person identifier, a party or authority handle, a document or its bytes, message content, an authentication secret, or any ballot/vote/tally/delegation reference (PACK-09 required invariants 1, 11, 12 and 13; Framework 0.8.1 section 11).
